premises.text: Today private aviation offers only two options: packed commercial flights or paying about 5,000 euros for private jets
premises.evidence_span: There's two options. Be treated like cattle or pay 5,000 euros

premises.text: A marketplace connects private pilots with passengers so they can share flight costs, with the platform handling booking, payments, pricing, matching, vetting, and insurance
premises.evidence_span: connecting private pilots with passengers so they can share the cost of a flight

premises.text: Flight Request lets passengers request a flight to a private pilot when it is not yet posted
premises.evidence_span: the first platform to actually allow you to request a flight to a private pilot easily

premises.text: A 2016 regulatory change clarified that private pilots may share flight costs and advertise flights beforehand
premises.evidence_span: a 2016 regulatory change made it clear for private pilots that they're allowed to share the cost of a flight and also advertise it on light beforehand

premises.text: A tailor-made insurance product adds about 1 million euro extra coverage on marketplace flights
premises.evidence_span: We developed a tailor-made insurance product that allows us to offer all our customers an extra 1 million euro coverage

premises.text: European private pilots fly with empty seats while planes sit idle much of the time, creating large unused capacity
premises.evidence_span: in average with 2 to 2.5 empty seats

value.text: Private aviation becomes accessible by combining convenience with pleasure through shared-cost flights
value.evidence_span: A solution that could combine convenience with pleasure

secondary_value.text: Win-win for pilots, passengers, and the environment via cheaper shared flights
secondary_value.evidence_span: it's a clear win-to-win for our pilots, our passengers, and also the environment
